def alpha (X b N : Ex) : NM NForm := do
  note .alpha
  let r ← fresh
  let s ← fresh
  let t ← fresh
  let u ← fresh
  let v ← fresh
  let w ← fresh
  let x ← fresh
  let y ← fresh
  let one ← constant 1
  let two ← constant 2
  andM [
    do lt (← constant 3) b,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [b, u, t]]) (← addL [← square u, ← square t])),
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [b, s, r]]) (← addL [← square s, ← square r])),
    lt r s,
    do divides (← square u) s,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [v, ← scale 2 r]) (← mulL [b, s])),
    congruent b v w,
    congruent two u w,
    lt two w,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [w, x, y]]) (← addL [← square x, ← square y])),
    do lt (← scale 2 X) u,
    do lt (← scale 2 X) v,
    congruent x v X,
    do lt (← scale 2 N) u,
    congruent x u N]

  (Q = 0 ∧ R = 0 ∧ P = 1) ∨ (Q = 0 ∧ 0 < R ∧ P = 0) ∨

      (P + b * a1) % m = (Q * a1 + a2) % m)

theorem saturatedArithmetic (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ x, saturate L x ≤ L ↔ x ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x k, k ≤ L → (saturate L x ≤ k ↔ x ≤ k)) ∧
    (∀ x, saturate L (saturate L x) = saturate L x) ∧ saturate L 0 = 0 ∧ saturate L 1 = 1 ∧
    (∀ x y, saturate L (saturate L x + saturate L y) = saturate L (x + y)) ∧
    (∀ x y, saturate L (saturate L x * saturate L y) = saturate L (x * y)) ∧
    (∀ x y, saturate L (max (saturate L x) (saturate L y)) = saturate L (max x y)) ∧
    (∀ x n, saturate L (saturate L x ^ n) = saturate L (x ^ n)) ∧
    (1 ≤ L → ∀ x n, saturate L (x ^ saturate L n) = saturate L (x ^ n)) ∧
    (1 ≤ L → ∀ x n, saturate L (saturate L x ^ saturate L n) = saturate L (x ^ n)) ∧
    (∀ n, saturate L (n + 1).factorial = saturate L (saturate L n.factorial * (n + 1))) :=

theorem jadd_affine (P Q : JTriple F) (hP : P.Z ≠ 0) (hQ : Q.Z ≠ 0) (hH : jH P Q ≠ 0) :
    let x₁ := P.X / P.Z ^ 2
    let y₁ := P.Y / P.Z ^ 3
    let x₂ := Q.X / Q.Z ^ 2
    let y₂ := Q.Y / Q.Z ^ 3
    let l := (y₂ - y₁) / (x₂ - x₁)
    x₁ ≠ x₂ ∧ (jadd P Q).Z ≠ 0 ∧ l = jΛ P Q / (jadd P Q).Z ∧
      (jadd P Q).X / (jadd P Q).Z ^ 2 = l ^ 2 - x₁ - x₂ ∧
      (jadd P Q).Y / (jadd P Q).Z ^ 3 = l * (x₁ - (jadd P Q).X / (jadd P Q).Z ^ 2) - y₁ := by

theorem packed_register_iff {B K q ι : ℕ} (hKB : K < B) (ρ α γ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ t ≤ q, ρ t < K) (hα : ∀ t ≤ q, α t ≤ 1) (hγ : ∀ t ≤ q, γ t ≤ 1) (hι : ι < K) :
    (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), ρ t * B ^ t) + B * (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), γ t * B ^ t) =
        ι + B * (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), ρ t * B ^ t) + B * (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), α t * B ^ t) ↔

structure PackedConditions (p : Program) (r k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → ℕ) (q c K B T F D : ℕ)
    (R N S V W : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop where
  c_pos : 0 < c
  hK : K = 2 ^ c
  hB : B = 4 * K
  m_lt : p.length < B
  hT : T = B ^ q
  inputs_lt : ∀ i : Fin k, a i < K
  hF : B * F + 1 = F + B * T
  hD : D + F = K * F
  sumS : ∑ i ∈ range p.length, S i = F
  lastS : S (p.length - 1) = T
  maskS : ∀ i < p.length, Nat.land (S i) F = S i
  maskR : ∀ j < r, Nat.land (R j) D = R j
  ltR : ∀ j < r, R j < T
  nonzero : ∀ j < r, K * N j = Nat.land (R j + D) (K * F)
  branch : ∀ i < p.length, ∀ j, decOn p j i → V i = Nat.land (S i) (N j) ∧ S i = V i + W i
  regEq : ∀ j < r, R j + B * decSum p V j = initFile a j + B * R j + B * incSum p S j
  stateEq : ∀ i < p.length, S i = (if i = 0 then 1 else 0) + B * inSum p S V W i

def alpha (X b N : Ex) : NM NForm := do
  note .alpha
  let r ← fresh
  let s ← fresh
  let t ← fresh
  let u ← fresh
  let v ← fresh
  let w ← fresh
  let x ← fresh
  let y ← fresh
  let one ← constant 1
  let two ← constant 2
  andM [
    do lt (← constant 3) b,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [b, u, t]]) (← addL [← square u, ← square t])),
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [b, s, r]]) (← addL [← square s, ← square r])),
    lt r s,
    do divides (← square u) s,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [v, ← scale 2 r]) (← mulL [b, s])),
    congruent b v w,
    congruent two u w,
    lt two w,
    do pure (.eq (← addL [one, ← mulL [w, x, y]]) (← addL [← square x, ← square y])),
    do lt (← scale 2 X) u,
    do lt (← scale 2 X) v,
    congruent x v X,
    do lt (← scale 2 N) u,
    congruent x u N]

theorem l1_estimates {ι : Type*} (f g : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (c : ℤ) (i : σ) (k : ℕ)
    (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℤ) :
    ((∀ α, (f.coeff α).natAbs ≤ l1 f) ∧ (l1 f = 0 ↔ f = 0)) ∧
    (l1 (C c : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) = c.natAbs ∧ l1 (X i : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) = 1 ∧
      l1 (-f) = l1 f ∧ l1 (C c * f) = c.natAbs * l1 f) ∧
    (l1 (f + g) ≤ l1 f + l1 g ∧ l1 (f * g) ≤ l1 f * l1 g ∧ l1 (f ^ k) ≤ l1 f ^ k ∧
      l1 (∑ j ∈ s, F j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, l1 (F j) ∧ l1 (∏ j ∈ s, F j) ≤ ∏ j ∈ s, l1 (F j)) ∧
    ((f + g).totalDegree ≤ max f.totalDegree g.totalDegree ∧
      (f * g).totalDegree ≤ f.totalDegree + g.totalDegree ∧
      (f ^ k).totalDegree ≤ k * f.totalDegree ∧
      (C c : MvPolynomial σ ℤ).totalDegree = 0 ∧ (X i : MvPolynomial σ ℤ).totalDegree ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ j ∈ s, F j).totalDegree ≤ s.sup (fun j => (F j).totalDegree) ∧
      (∏ j ∈ s, F j).totalDegree ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, (F j).totalDegree) :=

theorem pair_norm_estimates (u u' : PairRing σ) (c : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (e f : ℤ) (i j : σ)
    (_hij : i ≠ j) :
    (pairNorm (u + u') ≤ pairNorm u + pairNorm u' ∧ pairNorm (u - u') ≤ pairNorm u + pairNorm u' ∧
      pairNorm (c • u) = c.natAbs * pairNorm u) ∧
    (pairNorm (u * u') ≤ pairNorm u * pairNorm u' ∧ pairNorm (u ^ k) ≤ pairNorm u ^ k) ∧
    (pairDeg (u + u') ≤ max (pairDeg u) (pairDeg u') ∧ pairDeg (u * u') ≤ pairDeg u + pairDeg u') ∧
    (l1 u.re ≤ pairNorm u ∧ l1 u.im ≤ pairNorm u) ∧
    (pairNorm (⟨C e, C f⟩ : PairRing σ) = e.natAbs + 2 * f.natAbs ∧
      pairDeg (⟨C e, C f⟩ : PairRing σ) = 0 ∧
      pairNorm (⟨X i, X j⟩ : PairRing σ) = 3 ∧ pairDeg (⟨X i, X j⟩ : PairRing σ) = 1) :=

def Lift (x : ℕ → ℚ) : Formula → Prop
  | .eq a b => ev x a = ev x b
  | .atom f => ev x f = 0
  | .call τ g _ => τ.Rel fun k => ev x (g k)
  | .and fs => ∀ φ, (_ : φ ∈ fs) → Lift x φ
  | .or fs => ∃ φ, ∃ (_ : φ ∈ fs), Lift x φ

annotation.note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: The passage defines the catalogue, H_cat, N_s and M0 and asserts that the catalogue terminates, that M0 is a successful index, and that the guard's fixed point coordinates have nonzero denominators; [F] defines all of these as [M] does and proves the three facts unconditionally (infinite_catalogue_class, M0_bounds, iota_eq_psi_unconditional). Two packagings differ: normalizedRep takes c as the lcm of denominators (isNormalizedRep_iff proves it equal to the gcd form), and leastFormalMultiple is 0 when no index succeeds, which M0_bounds excludes; the closing remark asserts nothing.

theorem isNormalizedRep_iff {u : K0} {a b : ℤ} {c : ℕ} :

theorem mulByN_formulas_of_charZero {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] [DecidableEq K] (A : K)
    {x y : K} (h : (WA A).toAffine.Nonsingular x y) (n : ℤ) :
    (n • Affine.Point.some x y h = 0 ↔ psiEval A n x y = 0) ∧
    (n • Affine.Point.some x y h ≠ 0 →
      ∃ h' : (WA A).toAffine.Nonsingular
          (x - psiEval A (n + 1) x y * psiEval A (n - 1) x y / psiEval A n x y ^ 2)
          (psiEval A (2 * n) x y / (2 * psiEval A n x y ^ 4)),
        n • Affine.Point.some x y h = Affine.Point.some _ _ h') := by

instance euclideanDomain : EuclideanDomain Zs :=
  { (inferInstance : CommRing Zs), (inferInstance : Nontrivial Zs) with
    quotient := (· / ·)
    remainder := (· % ·)
    quotient_zero := fun x => by
      rw [div_def]; ext <;> simp

    r := _
    r_wellFounded := (measure (Int.natAbs ∘ QuadraticAlgebra.norm)).wf
    remainder_lt := natAbs_norm_mod_lt
    mul_left_not_lt := fun a _ hb0 => not_lt_of_ge <| natAbs_norm_le_mul a hb0 }

noncomputable def rawAddFormula (p q r : Code) (mg md : Pair) (ug ud : ℕ) : Formula :=
  let both : Formula := .and [fin p, fin q]
  .or [.and [isO p, peq q r],
    .and [fin p, isO q, peq p r],
    .and [both, feq p.x q.x, feq p.y q.y.neg, isO r],
    .and [both, nzFormula (q.x.sub p.x).norm ug, feq ((q.x.sub p.x).mul mg) (q.y.sub p.y),

    .and [both, feq p.x q.x, feq p.y q.y, nzFormula p.y.norm ud,
      feq ((Pair.smul 2 p.y).mul md) ((Pair.smul 3 p.x.sq).add Pair.A), addOut r p.x p.y q.x md]]

noncomputable def rawAddFormula (p q r : Code) (mg md : Pair) (ug ud : ℕ) : Formula :=
  let both : Formula := .and [fin p, fin q]
  .or [.and [isO p, peq q r],
    .and [fin p, isO q, peq p r],
    .and [both, feq p.x q.x, feq p.y q.y.neg, isO r],

    .and [both, feq p.x q.x, feq p.y q.y, nzFormula p.y.norm ud,
      feq ((Pair.smul 2 p.y).mul md) ((Pair.smul 3 p.x.sq).add Pair.A), addOut r p.x p.y q.x md]]

def contactSet : Finset ℚ := {0, -15, -20, -24, -30, -60}

noncomputable def contactSupport (S : Finset ℕ) (u : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ p ∈ (∏ c ∈ contactSet, (u - c).num.natAbs).primeFactors with
      p ∉ S ∧ ∃ c ∈ contactSet, 0 < padicValRat p (u - c) ∧ Odd (padicValRat p (u - c)),
    p
noncomputable def heightCcm : ℕ := 2 * heightBcm + 4096 * (1028 + 5 * heightD + 84000 * heightD ^ 2)
noncomputable def heightD : ℕ := heightF0 * 3 ^ (256 * heightF0 ^ 4)
noncomputable def heightE0 : ℕ := 10 * (heightD * heightG0) ^ 2

noncomputable def heightH6 (R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * 10 ^ 13 * max 1 (max (heightCcm : ℝ) (heightQ R ^ 17))

structure PrimaryData (A : Type) [AddCommGroup A] where
  sel : ℕ → Type
  [groupSel : ∀ j, AddCommGroup (sel j)]
  reduced : Type
  [groupReduced : AddCommGroup reduced]
  [finiteReduced : Finite reduced]
  d : ℕ
  bounded : ∃ j : ℕ, ∀ x : reduced, (2^j : ℕ) • x=0
  values : Type
  [groupValues : AddCommGroup values]
  pair : reduced →+ reduced →+ values
  alternating : ∀ x, pair x x=0
  nondegenerate : ∀ x, (∀ y, pair x y=0) → x=0
  kummer : ∀ j, quotientAt A (2^j) →+ sel j
  boundary : ∀ j, sel j →+ (Fin d → ZMod (2^j)) × torsionAt reduced (2^j)
  injective : ∀ j, Function.Injective (kummer j)
  surjective : ∀ j, Function.Surjective (boundary j)
  exactness : ∀ j, (kummer j).range=(boundary j).ker

  (∀ i : Fin 6, (v.bit i) ^ 2 - v.bit i = 0) ∧
  v.e * poleH B v * v.z * v.w = 1 ∧

  v.r2 ^ 2 = poleA B v *
    (poleA B v * v.z ^ 2 - v.e * poleH B v) *
    (poleA B v * v.z ^ 2 + 3 * v.e * poleH B v)

  not_mem_contactSet : t ∉ contactSet

structure EllipticKernelChart (v : AddValuation L (WithTop ℤ)) (b : L) where
  kernel : AddSubgroup (curve b).Point
  membership {Q : (curve b).Point} : 0<v (reciprocal Q) → parameter Q≠0 → Q∈kernel
  F : Type u
  [addGroup : AddCommGroup F]
  coordinate : F → L
  integral (X : F) : (1:WithTop ℤ)≤v (coordinate X)
  chart : kernel ≃+ F
  chart_parameter (Q : kernel) : coordinate (chart Q)=parameter Q.1

def glue (𝒞 : Config (S' ⊕ (Option G ⊕ G))) : Config (Option S') where
  cls := fun
    | none => ∏ o, 𝒞.cls (.inr (.inl o))
    | some s => 𝒞.cls (.inl s)
  cls_mem := fun
    | none => prod_mem_oddClasses _ _ fun _ _ => 𝒞.cls_mem _
    | some _ => 𝒞.cls_mem _
  bit := fun
    | some y, some y' => 𝒞.bit (.inl y) (.inl y')
    | some y, none => ∑ o, 𝒞.bit (.inl y) (.inr (.inl o))
    | none, some y => ∑ o, 𝒞.bit (.inr (.inl o)) (.inl y)
    | none, none => 0
  recip := by
    rintro (_ | x) (_ | y) h
    · exact absurd rfl h
    · show ∑ o, 𝒞.bit (.inr (.inl o)) (.inl y) + ∑ o, 𝒞.bit (.inl y) (.inr (.inl o)) =
        lam8 (∏ o, 𝒞.cls (.inr (.inl o))) * lam8 (𝒞.cls (.inl y))
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, lam8_prod _ _ fun _ _ => 𝒞.cls_mem _, Finset.sum_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => 𝒞.recip _ _ Sum.inr_ne_inl
    · show ∑ o, 𝒞.bit (.inl x) (.inr (.inl o)) + ∑ o, 𝒞.bit (.inr (.inl o)) (.inl x) =
        lam8 (𝒞.cls (.inl x)) * lam8 (∏ o, 𝒞.cls (.inr (.inl o)))
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, lam8_prod _ _ fun _ _ => 𝒞.cls_mem _, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => 𝒞.recip _ _ Sum.inl_ne_inr
    · exact 𝒞.recip _ _ fun e => h (congrArg some (Sum.inl_injective e))

theorem coeff_mul_at_one_two_exponent (n : Nat)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (ZMod 2))
    (hp : ∀ d ∈ p.support, ∀ i : Fin n, d i <= 1)
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ q.support, ∀ i : Fin n, d i <= 1)
    (s₁ s₂ : Finset (Fin n))
    (hdisj : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    (p * q).coeff
      (squarefreeExponent n s₁ + 2 • squarefreeExponent n s₂) =
      ∑ t ∈ s₁.powerset,
        p.coeff
          (squarefreeExponent n s₂ + squarefreeExponent n t) *
        q.coeff
          (squarefreeExponent n s₂ + squarefreeExponent n (s₁ \ t)) := by

theorem mixed_pair_cancellation {K R S D T Z : Type}
    (i : K → R) (s : S → D) (q : D → T) (jInv : T → S)
    (pairR : R → S → Z) (pairK : K → D → Z)
    (adjoint : ∀ x y, pairR (i x) y = pairK x (s y))
    (injective : ∀ a b, q a = q b → a = b)
    (rightInverse : ∀ y, q (s (jInv y)) = y) (x : K) (P : D) :
    pairR (i x) (jInv (q P)) = pairK x P := by

structure ModelRecipe where
  /-- The parameter count. -/
  parameterCount : ℕ
  /-- The variable count. -/
  variableCount : ℕ
  /-- The generator variable indices `g₀, g₁, g₂`. -/
  generator : Fin 3 → ℕ
  /-- Source variable rows `(r, s)`: a point reference and a natural start or none. -/
  sources : List (ℤ × Option ℕ)
  /-- Constant definitions `(σ, r, s)`: a scalar template, a point reference, a start. -/
  constants : List (ℕ × ℤ × ℕ)
  /-- The operations. -/
  operations : List Operation
  /-- The root equality `(r, r')`. -/
  rootEq : ℤ × ℤ
  /-- The natural template `ν`. -/
  natural : ℕ
  /-- The raw addition template `α`. -/
  addition : ℕ
  /-- The multiplication template `μ`. -/
  multiplication : ℕ
  /-- The power recipe `π`, if any. -/
  power : Option ℕ

noncomputable def ModelRecipe.conjuncts (templates recipes : List ExPoly) (r : ModelRecipe) :
    List Formula :=
  let ref := pointRefList r.generator
  let ν := getEx templates r.natural
  let α := getEx templates r.addition
  let μ := getEx templates r.multiplication
  let π := match r.power with
    | some i => getEx recipes i

noncomputable def ModelRecipe.conjuncts (templates recipes : List ExPoly) (r : ModelRecipe) :
    List Formula :=
  let ref := pointRefList r.generator
  let ν := getEx templates r.natural
  let α := getEx templates r.addition
  let μ := getEx templates r.multiplication
  let π := match r.power with
    | some i => getEx recipes i
    | none => ExPoly.empty
  (generatorConstraints r.generator).map .atom ++
    r.sources.filterMap (fun row => row.2.map fun s => callListFormula ν (ref row.1) s) ++
    r.constants.map (fun d =>
      callListFormula (getEx templates d.1) (ref (-2) ++ ref d.2.1) d.2.2) ++
    r.operations.map (fun
      | .add a b o s => callListFormula α (ref a ++ ref b ++ ref o) s
      | .mul a b o s => callListFormula μ (ref a ++ ref b ++ ref o) s
      | .power a b c o s => callListFormula π (ref a ++ ref b ++ ref c ++ ref o) s) ++
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin 5 =>
      pointRef r.generator r.rootEq.1 i - pointRef r.generator r.rootEq.2 i).map .atom

noncomputable def Pstar : MvPolynomial (Fin 292890231905) ℤ :=
  PstarOf specConstructors FixedConst.cstar.value FixedConst.ell.value FixedConst.T.value c3 N

noncomputable def generatorConstraints (g : Fin 3 → ℕ) : List Poly :=
  [8 * X (g 0) - 1641, 4 * X (g 1) + 15465, 32 * X (g 2) - 87483]

def integersRecipe (wValue : ℕ) : CompositionRecipe := CompM.run .sumSq 1 do
  let N ← CompM.fresh 5
  CompM.call (.recipe 5) (point N ++ [0]) wValue

noncomputable def pointRef (g : Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℤ → Fin 5 → Poly
  | .ofNat r => fun i => X (r + i)
  | .negSucc 0 => ![1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
  | .negSucc 1 => ![0, X (g 0), -145, X (g 1), X (g 2)]
  | .negSucc 2 => ![0, X (g 0), -145, -X (g 1), -X (g 2)]
  | .negSucc (_ + 3) => fun _ => 0
noncomputable def specPstar : MvPolynomial (Fin 292890231905) ℤ := Pstar (precisionCircuitOf c3) c3

noncomputable def Node.denote (I : Constructors E) (lib : List ExPoly) (vals : List Poly) :
    Node E → Poly
  | .const c => C c
  | .var i => X i
  | .add j k => getPoly vals j + getPoly vals k
  | .mul j k => getPoly vals j * getPoly vals k
  | .call t args w => (getEx lib t).callList (args.map (getPoly vals)) w
  | .fixed e => C (I.val e)
  | .psi e a c => bind₁ (fun i => getPoly vals (a i)) (I.psi (I.val e) c)
  | .guard e a => bind₁ (fun i => getPoly vals (a i)) (I.guard (I.val e))

snippet.text:
noncomputable def ModelRecipe.conjuncts (templates recipes : List ExPoly) (r : ModelRecipe) :
    List Formula :=
  let ref := pointRefList r.generator
  let ν := getEx templates r.natural
  let α := getEx templates r.addition
  let μ := getEx templates r.multiplication
  let π := match r.power with
    | some i => getEx recipes i
    | none => ExPoly.empty
  (generatorConstraints r.generator).map .atom ++
    r.sources.filterMap (fun row => row.2.map fun s => callListFormula ν (ref row.1) s) ++
    r.constants.map (fun d =>
      callListFormula (getEx templates d.1) (ref (-2) ++ ref d.2.1) d.2.2) ++
    r.operations.map (fun
      | .add a b o s => callListFormula α (ref a ++ ref b ++ ref o) s
      | .mul a b o s => callListFormula μ (ref a ++ ref b ++ ref o) s
      | .power a b c o s => callListFormula π (ref a ++ ref b ++ ref c ++ ref o) s) ++
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin 5 =>
      pointRef r.generator r.rootEq.1 i - pointRef r.generator r.rootEq.2 i).map .atom

theorem divided_shell (t h z : Int) (s : Nat) :
    let p := 2*t+1
    let a := p+1+4*h
    let k := 2*z+1
    let d := shell p a k (s+1)-shell p a k s
    2 ∣ d ∧ d/2 % 2 = (a-k-1)/2 % 2 := by
